item.title: Game Slams “Disgusting” Threesome Rumors With “Basketball Wives” Mom & Daughter
item.description: The Game denies having a threesome with Evelyn Lozada and daughter Shaniece Hairston, calling viral rumors “absurd.”

item.title: Rapper Ludacris Chooses Military Over MAGA At Florida Event
item.description: Ludacris headlines THE PLAYERS Military Day after ditching Kid Rock's MAGA festival. Fans celebrate his choice to honor troops over politics.

item.title: Atlanta Rappers’ Love For Wings Sparks New Georgia Legislation
item.description: Georgia lawmakers push bill to make lemon pepper the official state wing flavor, inspired by Atlanta Hip-Hop culture and Rick Ross's Wingstop empire.

item.title: Judge Rejects Pras Michel’s Bid to Avoid Prison Time, But Gives Rapper Small Break
item.description: Fugees rapper Pras Michel lost his bid to stay free during the appeal but won a two-month delay before reporting to prison.

item.title: Nicki Minaj Bathroom Controversy Blows Up On Social Media
item.description: Yvette Nicole Brown accuses Nicki Minaj of banning wardrobe staff from using bathrooms during house fittings. The shocking claim goes viral.

item.title: NLE Choppa Accused Of Leaving Daughter Bleeding At Studio, Rapper Hits Back
item.description: NLE Choppa's baby mama, Mariah, claims their daughter came home bleeding from his studio, sparking fresh neglect accusations.

item.title: Bad Bunny Plans Dress For Super Bowl Show & MAGA Snowflakes Can’t Stop Crying
item.description: Bad Bunny's rumored Super Bowl dress plan to honor queer icons has MAGA supporters calling for boycotts and threatening ICE raids at the game.

item.title: Latto Claps Back at Fivio Foreign Over Viral Claims
item.description: Latto fires back at Fivio Foreign after he used her old video amid his beef with 21 Savage, calling out his desperate grab for attention.

item.title: 50 Cent Teams With Jadakiss For DMX Origin Story Podcast
item.description: 50 Cent's G-Unit Audio teams with Jadakiss for "Look Thru My Eyes: Becoming DMX," his rise from the Yonkers streets to rap icon.

item.title: MO3 Murder Case Delayed So Yella Beezy Can Mourn Dead Mom
item.description: Yella Beezy's capital murder trial was postponed to August 24 after the rapper's mother died, and the defense cited a massive evidence dump in the MO3 case.
